summary: Fixes from the first real delivery on 1.9.0: intervention notes quote the person's reply as written, since a paraphrase of what a gate approval authorises was refused by Claude Code's auto-mode classifier; run_state.py gate ship takes --no-jira-write and --no-pr, so the ship gate no longer promises a Jira comment or a pull request that cannot happen from here; delivery-ship says so before shipping and reports a push that failed for lack of stored credentials with the one command that fixes it; delivery-doctor checks that the remote accepts a push without a prompt and that the build and test commands of the repository profile will not ask for permission during an unattended run.
